name: Shyvana
title: the Half-Dragon

Q.name: Emberstrike
Q.description: Passive: Shyvana's Attacks deal 0.01 + 0.0×bonus AD max Health magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit and reduce this Ability's Cooldown by 0.5 seconds. Active: Shyvana's next Attack strikes the target and the surrounding area dealing BASE_DAMAGE + 1.1×AD + 0.3×AP physical damage. This Ability may be Recast after an Attack or short delay within the next 4 seconds. Dragon Form: Shyvana gains an additional Recast, causing her to bite the target of her next Attack dealing (BASE_DAMAGE + 1.1×AD + 0.3×AP) × 1.5 true damage.
Q.summary: Shyvana's next attack strikes both the target and the surrounding area. This Ability can be recast. While in Dragon Form, it gains an additional recast, dealing massive damage to a single target.

W.name: Inferno Aegis
W.description: Shyvana wraps herself in flames for 2.5 seconds, gaining 60/80/100/120/140 + 0.12×bonus max HP Shield, increased by (60/80/100/120/140 + 0.12×bonus max HP) × 0.3 per nearby enemy champion and 0.25 Move Speed, increased to (0.25) × 1.75 when moving towards enemy champions. When the effect ends, the Shield is broken, or upon Recast the area around her detonates, dealing 80/100/120/140/160 + 0.65×AP magic damage. Dragon Form: If the detonation hits an enemy champion Shyvana heals for 60–100 (by level) + 0.04–0.08 (by level) Missing Health.
W.summary: Shyvana gains a shield, movement speed, and after a short delay, the area around her detonates. While in Dragon Form, the explosion will heal her if it strikes an enemy champion.

E.name: Molten Burst
E.description: Shyvana launches a fireball at the target location dealing 50/65/80/95/110 + 0.6/0.65/0.7/0.75/0.8×AP + 0.05 Max health magic damage and Slowing by 0.3 for 2 seconds. It explodes upon striking an enemy or reaching its terminus. Dragon Form: Shyvana's fireball is larger and pierces through enemies. Upon striking a champion, large monster, or reaching its terminus it triggers a pulse of fire that deals (50/65/80/95/110 + 0.6/0.65/0.7/0.75/0.8×AP) × 1.25 + (0.05) × 1.25 Max Health magic damage and Slows by (0.3) × 1 for 2 seconds. The fireball leaves behind a trail for 2 seconds that deals 15+ (by level) + 0.05×AP magic damage per second.
E.summary: Shyvana launches a fireball that explodes upon striking a large target and slows them. In Dragon Form, it passes through and explodes upon striking large enemies, leaving behind a trail of fire.

R.name: Dragon's Descent
R.description: Passive: Shyvana generates 1.25 Dragon Fury by striking enemies with Attacks and Abilities, increased by 3 + -1 while in Dragon Form, and reduced 1 + (-1 × 0.25) by when striking in an area against non-champions. Active: Shyvana transforms into her Dragon Form, becoming Unstoppable, and flying to the target location breathing fire on enemies below dealing 150/250/350 + 1×AP magic damage and causing them Flee for 0.75 seconds. While transformed, Shyvana's basic Abilities are upgraded, she gains 150/250/350 bonus Health, size, and Attack Range. Shyvana loses Dragon Fury over time and her transformation ends when she has no Dragon Fury remaining.
R.summary: Shyvana transforms into a Dragon and leaps forward causing enemies along her path to flee. While in Dragon form she becomes larger and her basic abilities are empowered.

Passive.name: Scalemail
Passive.description: Takedowns on enemy champions, large minions, and large monsters grant Shyvana Scalemail stacks, improving her defenses.
Passive.summary: Takedowns on enemy champions, large minions, and large monsters grant Shyvana Scalemail stacks, improving her defenses.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Dragon jungler who builds Dragon Fury to transform with R, flying unstoppably over enemies and making them flee. Wins fights with max-health fireballs and upgraded abilities in Dragon Form.
strengths: R: unstoppable flight that makes enemies flee (fear)
E fireball: max-health damage + slow, pierces in Dragon Form
W shield grows with nearby champions; move speed toward enemies
Q attacks deal max-health on-hit and reduce Q cooldown
Scalemail stacks from takedowns improve defences
weaknesses: No hard crowd control outside R
Dragon Form ends when Dragon Fury runs out

curve.lvl2: medium – Q + E clear, still no hard crowd control
curve.items: strong – first item (Nashor's Tooth for AP or a bruiser item for AD)

profile.curveNote: Farms until R; the transformation is her engage.
profile.mobility: medium – R flight; W move speed

Passive.notes: Scalemail stacks from takedowns improve defences.

Q.notes: Empowered attack hits area; may recast. Dragon Form: bite deals true damage.

W.notes: Shield (grows per nearby champion) + move speed.

E.notes: Fireball: max-health damage + slow; pierces in Dragon Form.

profile.windowAgainst: Before R, or after Dragon Fury runs out: she has no hard crowd control.
checks: Rework version: R Flee treated as fear.
